_README: Template for adding shows to data/live.json.
One entry per EVENT — a whole concert, festival set, broadcast special,
fanmeeting or award show. The unit is the show, not the song.
Copy a block below into the "events" array. Order in the file doesn't
matter: live.js sorts by "date" and groups by year on its own.
Set "series" so the filter chips pick it up:
A per-song cut from one of these shows does NOT go here — it stays on its
track in data/discography.json. This file is for the video you'd watch
Validate before committing:  python3 -m json.tool data/live.json

_FIELDS.id: REQUIRED. kebab-case, unique in this file. Used in the #deep-link.
_FIELDS.title: REQUIRED. As it should display. 'Lollapalooza Chicago 2022'.
_FIELDS.series: REQUIRED. tour | festival | special | fanmeeting | awards
_FIELDS.artist: OPTIONAL. Leave out for TWICE. A member's name for a solo show, or the unit's name for a sub-unit (MISAMO) — same as the discography credits it. It becomes the chip.
_FIELDS.venue: OPTIONAL. 'Grant Park, Chicago'. Shown under the title.
_FIELDS.date: REQUIRED. YYYY-MM-DD. A partial '2022-07' or '2022' also renders.
_FIELDS.note: OPTIONAL. One line of context. Leave "" for none.
_FIELDS.videos: The links. Same shape as discography.json — see _VIDEO below.
_FIELDS.members: OPTIONAL, only for a sub-unit: who's in it, e.g. "Mina, Sana, Momo". The chip still reads the "artist" name but takes a blend of their colours, and the member filter finds the show under each of them.

_VIDEO.kind: live for a concert/festival set, performance for an award-show or broadcast set. Also: special, other.
_VIDEO.url: Full YouTube URL, youtu.be link or bare 11-char id. A ?t= is kept and opens at that time.
_VIDEO.label: What this particular upload is: 'Full Set', 'Full Set (4K reupload)', 'Day 1'.
_VIDEO.official: true when the channel itself is official (the channel, never the title). false otherwise.
_VIDEO.fancam: OPTIONAL true — adds the ◉ Fancam tag. Independent of official.
_VIDEO.mustWatch: OPTIONAL true — adds the ★ Must watch pill. A hand-picked highlight; it doesn't reorder anything, use "pin" for that.
_VIDEO.pin: OPTIONAL true — sorts this video first within its event, ahead of the official-before-fan rule.
_VIDEO.thumb: OPTIONAL. Needed only for non-YouTube links (Vimeo, Bilibili).
_VIDEO.alt: OPTIONAL. A freely watchable copy of the SAME show, for when "url" is region-locked or behind a subscription (Amazon, Weverse, Beyond LIVE). The card opens this copy and moves "url" to an 'Original ↗' pill — one thumbnail, one watched mark, counted once. If "url" isn't a YouTube link the card borrows this one's thumbnail.
